reason: Project lens: no PROTECTED lines (grind_config PROTECT covers irq1_handler, not_vsync_2ed0, wait_for_vsync_2242; PROTECT_BYTES only &0004-&001E), not a generated source, no table or workspace moves (the routine-address tables at line 3650 stay, unread), main RAM code at &20xx-&21xx below &3000 so ACCCON X / ROMSEL do not matter; byte-neutral (LDA # 2 + STA abs 3 = 5 bytes, replaced by an unexecuted SKIP 5 after the always-taken BRA) so no region grows. move_mover_routine_address_high is referenced nowhere else in src/ or tools/ (grep); the low-byte self-mod label still sits at the JSR's *+1; the JSR's assembled high byte is HI(move_mover_up_and_right), equal to all four routines' (ASSERTed), and the old store always wrote exactly that before every JSR, so the executed instruction is identical on every path (both unplot_and_move_mover callers and move_mover's caller at line 3282, helicopter paths included); animate_mover starts LDA #&80 so the dropped A/N/Z are dead. Moved labels are taken from symbols by tools (passcost's move_mover phase). Branch page crossings checked in the shipping/bench listings (BRA &20E9->&2110 and BMI ->&20DF cross as before, BPL stays in page) and the gameplay listing (all within page &21 before and after), so the 6 cycles saved hold on every build.
